title: Git-Vacuum
summary: A keyboard-first terminal UI for backing up, browsing and synchronising every GitHub repository you own.
challenge: Mirror every repository you own locally with no backend, while keeping behind, ahead and dirty state visible while the sync runs.
decisions: Nine crates on hexagonal ports & adapters: service, app and TUI depend only on core traits
Unidirectional data flow — action, reducer, effect, app event, render
The GitHub token lives in the OS keyring, never in SQLite, logs or a plaintext file
SQLite in WAL mode is the local store; the GitHub API is the only outbound dependency
ownership: Designed and built the CLI and its sync engine end to end.

callouts.text: Every discovered repository with its ahead/behind counters.
A dirty badge for a working tree with uncommitted changes.
The bar is the repository's size on disk.
Sync status and the worker count for the run.
